name: Countess' Escape
source: Play as the fortune teller that will unveil the truth upon why the Countess is hiding from the Prince and what fate would the characters have due to your own choices. Their future relies on your hands.
translation: 扮演算命先生，揭开伯爵夫人为何躲避王子的真相，以及角色们因你的选择而有怎样的命运。他们的未来取决于你的双手。
